factions.name: Crown of Bretonnia
factions.role: King Charles's royal authority and court.

factions.name: Church of Bretonnia
factions.role: Powerful clerical institution represented by Archbishop Anselm; initially hostile or deeply suspicious toward dragons.

factions.name: Bretonnian Nobility
factions.role: Dukes, counts, knights, and courtly houses who embody the feudal and chivalric social order.

factions.name: Bretonnian Guilds
factions.role: Urban craft and merchant organizations forming a major part of the capital's economic life.

factions.name: Bernier's Conspirators
factions.role: Faction seeking to overthrow or destabilize King Charles; membership and aims are not yet defined.

factions.name: Lothar's Invasion Force
factions.role: Army that besieges King Charles and allied defenders; political origin and link to Bernier remain unresolved.
